description.zh:
系统架构。取值范围：</br>

- x86_64。

现只支持：x86_64。
description.en:
The system architecture. Valid value:
- x86\_64

description.zh:
`镜像类型`
ens_vm：ens虚机镜像（默认）
description.en: The type of the image. Valid value: `ens_vm` (ENS virtual machine image). Default value: `ens_vm`.

description.zh: 创建的自定义镜像信息列表。
description.en: A list of disk mappings that describe the source of the image file.
The OSS bucket that stores the image file.

description.zh: 镜像上传至OSS Bucket后，保存在Bucket中的镜像文件的文件名（key）。
description.en: The name (key) of the image file stored in the OSS bucket.
The region where the image is located.

description.zh:
镜像格式。取值范围：</br>
qcow2。</br>
当前只支持qcow2。
镜像名称。长度为[2, 128]个英文或中文字符。必须以大小字母或中文开头，不能以http://和https://开头。可以包含数字、半角冒号（:）、下划线（_）或者连字符（-）。
description.en: The name of the custom image. The name must be 2 to 128 characters long and must start with a letter or a Chinese character. It can contain digits, colons (:), underscores (\_), and hyphens (-). The name cannot start with `http://` or `https://`.
The OSS bucket where the image file is stored.
The name of the image file (object) in the OSS bucket.
The region where the source image is located. Currently, only `cn-beijing` is supported.

description.zh:
操作系统平台类型。取值范围：

- windows。
- linux。

暂时只支持：linux。
description.en:
The type of the operating system. Valid values:

- windows

- linux

Currently, only `linux` is supported.
The version of the operating system distribution.

description.zh:
操作系统发行版。取值范围：
* centos
* ubuntu
description.en:
The operating system distribution. Valid values:

- centos

- ubuntu

description.zh:
镜像要存储的目标OSS的区域。</br>

> 当前只支持cn-beijing与ap-southeast-1两个区域。
description.en:
The ID of the target region where the image will be stored.
> Currently, only the cn-beijing and ap-southeast-1 regions are supported.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ens import-image --image-name Image_name --compute-type ens_vm --oss-region cn-beijing --oss-bucket tmp-hybrid --oss-object image-test --os-type linux --platform centos --image-format qcow2 --architecture x86_64 --os-version 6.8 --disk-device-mapping OSSRegion=cn-beijing OSSObject=image-bucket OSSBucket=www-cn --target-oss-region-id cn-beijing --license-type example-string --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun ens ImportImage --region cn-hangzhou --OSSObject 'image-test' --Platform centos --Architecture x86_64 --TargetOSSRegionId 'cn-beijing' --DiskDeviceMapping '[{"OSSRegion":"cn-beijing","OSSObject":"image-bucket","OSSBucket":"www-cn"}]' --ComputeType ens_vm --ImageFormat qcow2 --LicenseType 'example-string' --ImageName Image_name --OSSRegion 'cn-beijing' --OSType linux --OSVersion '6.8' --OSSBucket 'tmp-hybrid'
